questions.stem: Which of the following is not generally a power of the board of directors of a corporation?
questions.explanation: The board runs the corporation: it appoints officers, sets their pay, and declares dividends. Amending the articles of incorporation changes the corporation's charter itself, which is a fundamental change reserved to the shareholders, although the board normally proposes it.
questions.explanationJa: 取締役会は会社を運営する機関であり、役員を選任し、その報酬を決め、配当を宣言する。基本定款（articles of incorporation）の変更は会社の根本規則そのものを変えるものであり、これは株主に留保された基礎的変更事項である（提案は通常、取締役会が行う）。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not true concerning corporations?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Directors owe a fiduciary duty to the corporation.

choices.label: B
choices.text: All shareholders owe a fiduciary duty to the corporation.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Officers owe a fiduciary duty to the corporation.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Directors who act in good faith may use the business judgment rule as a defense.

questions.explanation: Directors and officers are fiduciaries because they manage other people's money. Ordinary shareholders are simply investors and owe no such duty; only a controlling shareholder, who can direct the corporation's affairs, takes on a fiduciary obligation to the minority.
questions.explanationJa: 取締役と役員は他人の財産を管理する立場にあるため受託者責任を負う。一般の株主は単なる投資家であってそのような義務は負わない。会社の運営を左右できる支配株主だけが、少数株主に対する受託者責任を負う。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a right of the shareholder of a corporation?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Right to inspect the books and records.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Right to share in dividends if declared.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Right to determine the mission of the corporation.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Right to sue on behalf of the corporation if the officers and directors fail to uphold corporate rights.

questions.explanation: Shareholders hold ownership rights: inspection of books and records for a proper purpose, a share of any dividend the board declares, and the right to bring a derivative suit when management will not act. Setting the mission is a management and board function; shareholders influence it only indirectly, by electing directors.
questions.explanationJa: 株主が持つのは所有者としての権利である。正当な目的があれば帳簿・記録を閲覧でき、取締役会が宣言した配当の分配を受け、経営陣が動かないときには株主代表訴訟を提起できる。会社の使命を定めることは経営陣と取締役会の職務であり、株主は取締役を選任することを通じて間接的に影響を及ぼすにとどまる。

questions.stem: Which of the following actions normally requires shareholder approval?

choices.label: D
choices.text: Changing the nature of the corporation.

questions.explanation: Shareholder approval is reserved for fundamental changes: amending the articles, merging, selling substantially all assets, or dissolving, all of which alter the nature of the enterprise the shareholders invested in. Appointing the CEO, declaring dividends, and approving strategy are board functions.
questions.explanationJa: 株主の承認が必要となるのは基礎的変更である。定款変更、合併、事業の全部または重要な一部の譲渡、解散がこれにあたり、いずれも株主が投資した企業の性質そのものを変えるものである。CEOの選任、配当の宣言、戦略の承認は取締役会の職務である。

questions.stem: To which of the following rights is a stockholder of a public corporation entitled?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The right to have annual dividends declared and paid.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The right to vote for the election of officers.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The right to a reasonable inspection of corporate records.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The right to have the corporation issue a new class of stock.

questions.explanation: A shareholder may inspect corporate records for a proper purpose. The other three are not rights: dividends are declared at the board's discretion, shareholders elect directors rather than officers, and issuing a new class of stock requires board action and a charter amendment.
questions.explanationJa: 株主は正当な目的があれば会社の記録を閲覧できる。他の3つは権利ではない。配当は取締役会の裁量で宣言されるものであり、株主が選任するのは役員ではなく取締役であり、新たな種類株式の発行には取締役会の決議と定款変更が必要である。

questions.stem: Which of the following is correct with respect to the rights of stockholders in a corporation?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Stockholders have no right to manage their corporation unless they are also directors or officers.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Stockholders have a right to receive dividends.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Stockholders have no right to inspect the books and records of their corporation.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Stockholders have a right to get a list of their corporation’s customers to use for a business mailing list.

questions.explanation: Ownership and management are separate: a shareholder has no authority to run the business unless he or she also holds a director or officer position. Shareholders do have inspection rights for a proper purpose, which is why C is wrong and why D is wrong as well, since a mailing list is not a proper purpose. Dividends are never a matter of right.
questions.explanationJa: 所有と経営は分離している。株主は、取締役や役員の地位を兼ねていない限り、事業を運営する権限を持たない。株主には正当な目的による閲覧権があるのでCは誤りであり、宣伝用の名簿作成は正当な目的にあたらないのでDも誤りである。配当は決して権利として請求できるものではない。

questions.stem: A corporate stockholder is entitled to which of the following rights?
questions.explanation: Dissolution is a fundamental change and therefore requires a shareholder vote. Shareholders elect directors, not officers; dividends depend on a board declaration; and borrowing is an ordinary business decision that shareholders cannot block.
questions.explanationJa: 解散は基礎的変更にあたるので株主の議決を要する。株主が選任するのは取締役であって役員ではなく、配当は取締役会の宣言によって初めて生じ、借入は通常の事業判断であって株主が阻止できるものではない。

questions.stem: Which of the following best identifies the reason that effective corporate governance is important?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The separation of ownership from management.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Lack of oversight by boards of directors.

questions.explanation: Corporate governance exists to manage the agency problem created when the people who own the firm are not the people who run it. Managers may pursue their own interests, so mechanisms such as an independent board, auditors, and disclosure are needed to align them with the owners. Excess pay and weak boards are symptoms of that separation, not the underlying reason.
questions.explanationJa: コーポレートガバナンスは、会社を所有する者と運営する者が別人であることから生じるエージェンシー問題に対処するために存在する。経営者は自らの利益を追求しうるので、独立した取締役会・監査人・開示といった仕組みによって所有者と利害を一致させる必要がある。過大な報酬や機能しない取締役会は、この分離がもたらす症状であって、根本的な理由ではない。

questions.stem: The articles of incorporation and bylaws of a corporation serve as a basis for the governance structure of a corporation. Which of the following items are normally included in the bylaws of the corporation as opposed to the articles of incorporation?

choices.label: B
choices.text: Number of authorized shares of stock.

questions.explanation: The articles are the charter filed with the state and contain the corporation's identity: its purpose, powers, and authorized shares. The bylaws are the internal operating rules the corporation adopts for itself, covering procedures such as how directors are elected, when meetings are held, and what each officer does.
questions.explanationJa: 基本定款（articles）は州に提出される設立の根本規則であり、会社の同一性を定める事項、すなわち目的・権限・授権株式数を含む。附属定款（bylaws）は会社が自ら定める内部の運営規則であり、取締役の選任手続、会議の開催時期、各役員の職務といった手続的事項を扱う。

questions.stem: Which of the following forms of compensation would most likely align management’s behavior with the interests of the shareholders?

choices.label: B
choices.text: A salary plus a bonus based on current period net income.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A salary plus stock options that cannot be exercised for 10 years.

questions.explanation: Options that cannot be exercised for ten years pay off only if the share price is higher a decade out, so management is rewarded for building durable value rather than for this year's reported figures. A fixed salary provides no link to performance at all, and a bonus tied to current net income invites short-term manipulation.
questions.explanationJa: 10年間行使できないストックオプションは、10年後に株価が上がっていて初めて価値を持つので、経営陣は今年の報告数値ではなく持続的な価値の構築によって報われる。固定給は業績と全く連動せず、当期純利益に連動する賞与は短期的な利益操作を招く。

questions.stem: Which of the following forms of compensation would encourage management to take on excessive risk?

choices.label: B
choices.text: A salary and bonuses based on current period net income.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A salary plus stock options that cannot be exercised for 10 years.

questions.explanation: A bonus on current period net income is one-sided: management captures the upside of a gamble that pays off this year but bears none of the loss if it fails later, so the rational response is to take more risk. Restricted stock and long-dated options expose the holder to the downside as well, and a fixed salary gives no risk incentive at all.
questions.explanationJa: 当期純利益に連動する賞与は片側だけの報酬である。今年うまくいった賭けの成果は経営陣が手にする一方、後年に失敗しても損失は負わないので、合理的な対応はリスクを増やすことになる。譲渡制限株式や長期のオプションは保有者を下振れにもさらし、固定給にはリスクを取る誘因が全くない。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a duty that is typically reserved for the board of directors of a corporation?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Selection and removal of the chief executive officer.

questions.explanation: Hiring and firing the CEO, setting executive pay, and declaring dividends are all core board functions. Amending the articles of incorporation is not: the board may propose the amendment, but only the shareholders can approve it.
questions.explanationJa: CEOの選解任、役員報酬の決定、配当の宣言は、いずれも取締役会の中核的な職務である。基本定款の変更はこれにあたらない。取締役会は変更を提案できるが、承認できるのは株主だけである。

questions.stem: Which of the following is a legal rule that prevents directors from being held liable for making bad decisions if they act with good faith, loyalty, and due care?
questions.explanation: The business judgment rule protects directors who act in good faith, with loyalty to the corporation, and on an informed basis. Courts will not second-guess the substance of such a decision even when it turns out badly, because directors would otherwise refuse to take any commercial risk.
questions.explanationJa: 経営判断の原則（business judgment rule）は、誠実に、会社への忠実義務に従い、十分な情報に基づいて行動した取締役を保護する。裁判所は、結果的に失敗した判断であっても、その内容の当否を事後的に問い直さない。そうしなければ取締役が一切の事業リスクを取らなくなってしまうからである。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a requirement of the New York Stock Exchange regarding corporate governance of companies listed on the exchange?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Have a majority of independent directors of the corporate board.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Adopt and make publicly available a code of conduct.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Prohibit the chief financial officer from serving on the board of directors.

questions.explanation: The NYSE requires a majority of independent directors, a published code of business conduct, and fully independent audit, compensation, and nominating committees. It does not bar the CFO from sitting on the board; what it bars is the CFO sitting on those independent committees.
questions.explanationJa: NYSEは、取締役の過半数が独立社外取締役であること、行動規範を公表すること、監査・報酬・指名の各委員会を完全に独立させることを求めている。CFOが取締役会に加わること自体は禁じていない。禁じられているのは、CFOがこれら独立性を要する委員会に入ることである。

questions.stem: Which of the following does not act as an external corporate governance mechanism?
questions.explanation: External mechanisms operate from outside the company: auditors, the SEC, and credit analysts all scrutinize it without being part of it. The board of directors is an internal organ of the corporation, and its independence makes it a strong internal mechanism, not an external one.
questions.explanationJa: 外部的な仕組みとは、会社の外側から働くものを指す。外部監査人・SEC・信用アナリストはいずれも会社の一部ではない立場から監視する。取締役会は会社の内部機関であり、その独立性は強力な内部的仕組みを意味するのであって、外部的な仕組みではない。

questions.stem: The Sarbanes-Oxley Act provides that at least one member of the audit committee should be

choices.label: B
choices.text: The chief financial officer of the company.

questions.explanation: Sarbanes-Oxley requires the issuer to disclose whether at least one audit committee member is a financial expert, and if not, why not. Independence is required of every member, so it is not the distinguishing requirement, and the Act does not require a CPA. The CFO is by definition not independent and cannot serve.
questions.explanationJa: サーベンス・オクスリー法は、監査委員会の少なくとも1名が財務専門家（financial expert）であるかどうかを開示し、いない場合はその理由を説明することを発行体に求めている。独立性は全委員に要求されるので、この設問を分ける要件にはならない。同法はCPA資格までは求めていない。CFOは定義上独立していないので委員にはなれない。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a statutory requirement regarding the committees of the board of directors of publicly held corporations registered with the SEC?

choices.label: A
choices.text: All members of the compensation committee must be independent.

choices.label: B
choices.text: At least one member of the compensation committee must be a “compensation expert.”

choices.label: C
choices.text: All members of the audit committee must be independent.

choices.label: D
choices.text: At least one member of the audit committee must be a “financial expert.”

questions.explanation: Statute requires independence for both committees and a disclosed financial expert on the audit committee. There is no such thing as a required compensation expert; the compensation committee must instead consider the independence of any adviser it retains.
questions.explanationJa: 法令が要求しているのは、両委員会の独立性と、監査委員会における財務専門家の開示である。報酬専門家の設置を義務づける規定は存在しない。報酬委員会に求められるのは、起用する助言者の独立性を検討することである。

questions.stem: Which of the following is necessary to be an audit committee financial expert according to the criteria specified in the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002?

choices.label: A
choices.text: An understanding of income tax law.

choices.label: B
choices.text: An understanding of generally accepted accounting principles and financial statements.

choices.label: D
choices.text: An understanding of corporate governance rules and procedures.

questions.explanation: The definition centres on accounting: the expert must understand GAAP and financial statements, have experience preparing or auditing comparable statements, grasp internal control over financial reporting, and understand audit committee functions. Tax, corporate law, and governance procedures are not part of the test.
questions.explanationJa: この定義の中心は会計にある。専門家は、GAAPと財務諸表を理解し、同等の財務諸表を作成または監査した経験を持ち、財務報告に係る内部統制を把握し、監査委員会の機能を理解していなければならない。税務・会社法・ガバナンス手続はこの要件に含まれない。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a requirement of the Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection (Dodd- Frank) Act for publicly held corporations registered with the SEC?

choices.label: A
choices.text: If it is decided that the CEO should also be appointed chairman of the board, the corporation must disclose why this decision was made.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The members of the compensation committee of the board must be independent.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Shareholders must be allowed a nonbinding vote on officer compensation at least every three years.

choices.label: D
choices.text: All members of the audit committee of the board must be financial experts.

questions.explanation: Dodd-Frank requires disclosure of the board leadership structure, an independent compensation committee, and a nonbinding say-on-pay vote at least every three years. It does not require every audit committee member to be a financial expert; Sarbanes-Oxley asks only for one, on a disclose-or-explain basis.
questions.explanationJa: ドッド・フランク法が求めているのは、取締役会のリーダーシップ構造の開示、報酬委員会の独立性、そして少なくとも3年に1度の拘束力のない報酬に関する議決（say-on-pay）である。監査委員会の全員が財務専門家であることは求めていない。サーベンス・オクスリー法が求めるのも1名だけであり、それも開示するか理由を説明するかという形式である。

questions.stem: Which of the following is most effective as an external monitoring device for a publicly held corporation than the others?
questions.explanation: External auditors examine the financial statements every year and are independent of management, so they provide continuous outside scrutiny of the numbers investors rely on. Internal auditors are employees, the SEC reviews filings only periodically and selectively, and attorneys act as advisers to the company.
questions.explanationJa: 外部監査人は毎年財務諸表を検査し、経営陣から独立しているため、投資家が依拠する数値に対して継続的な外部からの監視を提供する。内部監査人は従業員であり、SECの提出書類の審査は定期的かつ選択的にしか行われず、弁護士は会社の助言者として行動する立場である。

questions.stem: An important corporate governance mechanism is the internal auditor function. For good corporate governance, the chief internal audit executive should have direct communication to the audit committee and report to
questions.explanation: The dual reporting line is the point: functionally the chief audit executive reports to the audit committee, which protects independence, while administratively reporting to the CEO. Reporting to the CFO or controller would place internal audit under the very finance function it must examine.
questions.explanationJa: 二重の報告経路がこの設問の要点である。内部監査部門長は、機能的には監査委員会へ報告することで独立性が守られ、組織上（管理上）はCEOへ報告する。CFOやコントローラーへ報告する形にすると、内部監査が、まさに自らが検証すべき経理財務部門の下に置かれてしまう。

questions.stem: In setting priorities for internal audit activities, the chief audit executive should

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use an approach that cycles audit areas each year.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use a random approach to more likely detect fraud.

questions.explanation: Internal audit resources are limited, so they should be directed where the risk of loss or misstatement is greatest, and the plan is reassessed as risks change. Following management's priorities compromises independence, and cycling or randomizing coverage spends effort on low-risk areas.
questions.explanationJa: 内部監査の資源は限られているので、損失や虚偽表示のリスクが最も大きいところへ振り向けるべきであり、監査計画はリスクの変化に応じて見直される。経営陣の優先順位に従えば独立性が損なわれ、順繰りや無作為に対象を選べば低リスク領域に労力を費やすことになる。

questions.stem: The Institute of Internal Auditors’ International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing cover what two major types of internal auditing services?
questions.explanation: The IIA Standards divide internal audit work into assurance services, in which the auditor forms an independent assessment for third parties, and consulting services, which are advisory and agreed with the client. The other pairings describe types of engagement or of practitioner, not the Standards' own division.
questions.explanationJa: IIA基準は内部監査の業務を2つに分けている。アシュアランス業務は、監査人が第三者のために独立した評価を形成するものであり、コンサルティング業務は、依頼者と合意したうえで行う助言的なものである。他の組み合わせは業務の種類や実施者の区分であって、基準自身が設けている分類ではない。

questions.stem: According to the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

choices.label: A
choices.text: All internal audit seniors must be Certified Internal Auditors.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The internal auditors must establish and maintain a system to monitor the disposition of audit results.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Internal auditors must be assigned to assist the external auditors.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Internal auditors must not have a financial interest in the company.

questions.explanation: The Standards require the chief audit executive to establish and maintain a follow-up process so that reported findings are actually acted on; an audit that ends at the report changes nothing. Certification is not mandatory, assisting the external auditors is optional, and a financial interest is addressed through the objectivity requirements rather than an outright ban.
questions.explanationJa: 基準は、報告した指摘事項が実際に対処されるよう、内部監査部門長がフォローアップの仕組みを構築し維持することを求めている。報告書を出して終わる監査では何も変わらないからである。資格認定は必須ではなく、外部監査人への協力も任意であり、財務的利害については全面禁止ではなく客観性の要件を通じて対処される。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a section of the Institute of Internal Auditors’ International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing?
questions.explanation: The IIA framework has three sections: Attribute Standards, describing the characteristics of the audit activity and its people; Performance Standards, describing the nature of the work and its quality criteria; and Implementation Standards, which apply the first two to specific engagements. There is no separate section for independence, which is dealt with inside the Attribute Standards.
questions.explanationJa: IIAの枠組みは3つの部分からなる。属性基準（Attribute Standards）は監査活動とその要員の特性を定め、実施基準（Performance Standards）は業務の性質と品質の判定規準を定め、適用基準（Implementation Standards）は前二者を個々の業務に適用する。独立性のための独立した区分は存在せず、独立性は属性基準の中で扱われる。

questions.stem: Securities analysts act as one form of monitoring device from a corporate governance standpoint. What is a limitation that is often identified when considering the effectiveness of securities analysts in this regard?

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use of only nonfinancial information for analyses.

choices.label: D
choices.text: They are employees of the company.

questions.explanation: Analysts have historically been paid by firms that also earn investment banking fees from the companies being covered, and they need continued access to management, both of which create pressure to publish favourable opinions. That conflict of interest, not incompetence, is the standard criticism. Analysts are not company employees and they work primarily from financial data.
questions.explanationJa: アナリストは歴史的に、調査対象企業から投資銀行業務の手数料も得ている会社に雇用されており、また経営陣への継続的なアクセスを必要とするため、その双方が好意的な見解を出す圧力を生む。標準的に指摘される限界は、能力不足ではなくこの利益相反である。アナリストは対象企業の従業員ではなく、分析は主に財務データに基づいて行われる。

questions.stem: Which of the following divisions of the SEC reviews corporate filings?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The Office of the Chief Accountant.

questions.explanation: The Division of Corporation Finance reviews registration statements and periodic filings such as Forms 10-K and 10-Q for compliance with disclosure requirements. The Division of Enforcement investigates suspected violations, and the Office of the Chief Accountant sets accounting and auditing policy for the Commission.
questions.explanationJa: 企業財務部（Division of Corporation Finance）は、登録届出書やForm 10-K・10-Qといった継続開示書類を、開示要件への適合という観点から審査する。執行部（Division of Enforcement）は違反の疑いを調査し、主任会計官室（Office of the Chief Accountant）はSECの会計・監査方針を定める部署である。

questions.stem: According to the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, which of the following statements is correct regarding an issuer’s audit committee financial expert?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The issuer’s current outside CPA firm’s audit partner must be the audit committee financial expert.

choices.label: B
choices.text: If an issuer does not have an audit committee financial expert, the issuer must disclose the reason why the role is not filled.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The issuer must fill the role with an individual who has experience in the issuer’s industry.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The audit committee financial expert must be the issuer’s audit committee chairperson to enhance internal control.

questions.explanation: The requirement is disclose-or-explain: the issuer must say whether it has at least one audit committee financial expert and, if not, why not. Nothing compels it to appoint one. The expert cannot be the current audit partner, who would not be independent, need not have industry experience, and need not chair the committee.
questions.explanationJa: この要件は「開示するか、理由を説明するか」という形式である。発行体は、監査委員会に財務専門家が少なくとも1名いるかどうかを述べ、いない場合はその理由を説明しなければならない。専門家の選任自体を強制する規定はない。専門家は独立性を欠くため現任の監査パートナーではあり得ず、当該業界の経験も、委員長を務めることも要求されていない。

questions.stem: Which of the following components is considered the foundation of the internal controls established by an organization?
questions.explanation: The control environment sets the tone: management's integrity, the board's oversight, the assignment of authority, and the competence of people. Every other component rests on it, because well-designed control activities are worthless if the people applying them are not held to account.
questions.explanationJa: 統制環境が組織の基調を定める。経営陣の誠実性、取締役会による監督、権限の割当て、要員の適性がこれにあたる。他のすべての構成要素はこの上に成り立つ。統制活動をどれだけ精緻に設計しても、それを運用する人々が責任を問われないのであれば意味をなさないからである。

questions.stem: Which of the following COSO categories of objectives includes safeguarding of assets?
questions.explanation: COSO recognizes three categories of objectives: operations, reporting, and compliance. Safeguarding of assets is about the efficient and effective use of resources and preventing their loss, which places it under operations. Financing is not one of the categories.
questions.explanationJa: COSOは目的を3つのカテゴリーに分類している。業務（operations）、報告（reporting）、コンプライアンス（compliance）である。資産の保全は、資源を効率的・効果的に使用し、その喪失を防ぐことに関わるので、業務のカテゴリーに属する。財務（financing）はカテゴリーに含まれない。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a principle related to the component of the control environment?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Demonstrate a commitment to integrity and ethical values.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Demonstrate a commitment to attract, develop and retain competent individuals.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Identify and assess changes that could significantly impact the system of internal control.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Hold individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities.

questions.explanation: The five control environment principles concern integrity and ethical values, board oversight, structure and authority, competence, and accountability. Identifying and assessing significant change is one of the four risk assessment principles, not a control environment principle.
questions.explanationJa: 統制環境の5つの原則が扱うのは、誠実性と倫理観、取締役会による監督、組織構造と権限、適格性、そして責任の明確化である。重要な変化を識別し評価することは、リスク評価の4原則の一つであって、統制環境の原則ではない。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not true regarding the information and communication component of internal control?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The information system captures both internal and external sources of data.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The information and communication component involves developing channels for communication from external stakeholders.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A whistle-blower hotline is an important aspect of the information and communication component.

choices.label: D
choices.text: An important aspect of the information and communication component is assessment of information about fraud.

questions.explanation: Information and communication is about capturing relevant data from inside and outside the entity and moving it to the people who need it, including upward channels such as a whistle-blower hotline. Assessing information about fraud, that is, considering the potential for fraud in evaluating risks, is a risk assessment principle.
questions.explanationJa: 情報と伝達は、組織の内外から関連するデータを収集し、それを必要とする人々へ届けることに関わる要素であり、内部通報ホットラインのような上向きの経路もこれに含まれる。不正に関する情報の評価、すなわちリスクを評価するにあたって不正の可能性を検討することは、リスク評価の原則に属する。

questions.stem: According to the COSO framework, evaluators that monitor controls within an organization should have which of the following set of characteristics?
questions.explanation: Monitoring is only as good as the person doing it. The evaluator must know enough about the control and the underlying process to judge whether it is working, which is competence, and must be sufficiently removed from the activity to report what is found, which is objectivity.
questions.explanationJa: モニタリングの質は、それを行う人によって決まる。評価者は、統制とその基礎となる業務を判断できるだけ理解していなければならず（適格性）、発見した事実をそのまま報告できる程度にその活動から距離を置いていなければならない（客観性）。

questions.stem: Which of the following is a general control rather than a transaction control activity?
questions.explanation: General controls apply across the whole technology environment rather than to any one transaction stream: they cover technology acquisition and development, infrastructure, and security. Reconciliations, physical controls, and controls over standing data all operate on particular transactions or records.
questions.explanationJa: 全般統制は、個々の取引の流れではなく、技術環境全体に及ぶ統制であり、技術の取得と開発、インフラ、セキュリティを対象とする。照合、物理的統制、マスタデータに対する統制は、いずれも特定の取引や記録に対して働くものである。

questions.stem: According to COSO, the use of ongoing and separate evaluations to establish a new baseline after changes have been made can best be accomplished in which of the following stages of the monitoring- for-change continuum?
questions.explanation: The continuum runs control baseline, change identification, change management, and control revalidation. Change management is the stage at which the effect of a known change is evaluated and the baseline is reset to reflect the controls as they now operate.
questions.explanationJa: この連続体は、統制のベースライン設定、変化の識別、変化の管理、統制の再検証という順に進む。変化の管理は、把握された変化の影響を評価し、現に運用されている統制を反映するようベースラインを設定し直す段階である。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a type of control under the control activity component of the COSO framework for internal control?
questions.explanation: Control activities include authorizations, verifications, reconciliations, performance reviews, physical controls, and segregation of duties, together with supervisory controls over them. Monitoring is a separate component of the framework in its own right, not a category of control activity.
questions.explanationJa: 統制活動には、承認、検証、照合、業績のレビュー、物理的統制、職務の分離が含まれ、それらを監督する統制も含まれる。モニタリングはフレームワーク上、それ自体が独立した構成要素であり、統制活動の一類型ではない。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a control environment factor?

choices.label: B
choices.text: Board of directors or audit committee.

questions.explanation: Control environment factors are the elements that shape the organization's attitude toward control: integrity and ethical values, board and audit committee oversight, management's philosophy, organizational structure, assignment of authority, and human resources policies. Monitoring is a distinct component.
questions.explanationJa: 統制環境の要素とは、統制に対する組織の姿勢を形作るもの、すなわち誠実性と倫理観、取締役会・監査委員会による監督、経営者の理念、組織構造、権限の割当て、人事に関する方針と手続である。モニタリングはこれとは別個の構成要素である。

questions.stem: Which of the following components of internal control would encompass the routine controls over business processes and transactions?
questions.explanation: Control activities are the policies and procedures embedded in day-to-day processing: approvals, matching, reconciliations, and segregation of duties. The control environment sets the tone, risk assessment identifies what could go wrong, and information and communication moves the data.
questions.explanationJa: 統制活動とは、日々の処理に組み込まれた方針と手続であり、承認、照合、突合、職務の分離がこれにあたる。統制環境は基調を定め、リスク評価は何が起こりうるかを識別し、情報と伝達はデータを流通させる役割を担う。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a component in the COSO framework for internal control?
questions.explanation: The five components are the control environment, risk assessment, control activities, information and communication, and monitoring. Segregation of duties is not a component; it is one specific control activity within the third component.
questions.explanationJa: 5つの構成要素とは、統制環境、リスク評価、統制活動、情報と伝達、モニタリングである。職務の分離は構成要素ではなく、3番目の構成要素の中にある個別の統制活動の一つである。

questions.stem: Management of Johnson Company is considering implementing technology to improve the monitoring component of internal control. Which of the following best describes how technology may be effective at improving monitoring?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Technology can identify conditions and circumstances that indicate that controls have failed or risks are present.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Technology can assure that items are processed accurately.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Technology can provide information more quickly.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Technology can control access to terminals and data.

questions.explanation: Monitoring asks whether the controls are still working. Technology serves that purpose by continuously scanning transactions and system data for the conditions that signal a failed control or an emerging risk, and flagging them for follow-up. Choices B, C, and D describe processing accuracy, timeliness, and access security, which are control activities rather than monitoring.
questions.explanationJa: モニタリングが問うのは、統制が今も機能しているかどうかである。技術がその役に立つのは、取引やシステムのデータを継続的に走査し、統制の不備や新たなリスクを示す兆候を検出して、追跡調査のために警告できるからである。選択肢B・C・Dが述べているのは処理の正確性、迅速性、アクセスの安全性であり、これらはモニタリングではなく統制活動にあたる。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a limitation of internal control?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Human judgment in decision-making may be faulty.

choices.label: B
choices.text: External forces may attack the system.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Controls may be circumvented by collusion.

questions.explanation: The recognized inherent limitations arise from inside the system: faulty human judgment, breakdowns due to error, management override, and collusion, plus the cost-benefit constraint. Attack by external forces is an external threat that internal control is designed to guard against, not a limitation of the concept.
questions.explanationJa: 認識されている固有の限界は、システムの内側から生じるものである。人間の判断の誤り、過誤による機能不全、経営者による無効化、共謀、そして費用対効果の制約がこれにあたる。外部からの攻撃は、内部統制が防ぐべく設計されている外部の脅威であって、内部統制という概念そのものの限界ではない。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not required under Section 404 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A statement of management’s responsibility for establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial reporting.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A statement indicating that the board of directors has approved the system of internal control over financial reporting.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A statement identifying the framework used to assess internal control over financial reporting.

choices.label: D
choices.text: An assessment of the effectiveness of the corporation’s internal control over financial reporting.

questions.explanation: Section 404(a) calls for management to state its responsibility for internal control over financial reporting, identify the framework used, and assess effectiveness as of year-end. There is no requirement that the board approve the system; the board's role is oversight, not certification.
questions.explanationJa: 第404条(a)が求めているのは、経営者が財務報告に係る内部統制に対する自らの責任を表明し、使用した枠組みを明示し、期末時点の有効性を評価することである。取締役会が内部統制システムを承認することは要求されていない。取締役会の役割は監督であって、証明ではない。

questions.stem: Which of the following would generally be entitled to a reward for whistle-blowing under the Dodd-Frank Act?

choices.label: A
choices.text: An external auditor who discovers a violation while performing an audit of company’s financial statement and internal control under SEC requirements.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A customer of a company who discovers a violation in the course of doing business with the company.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A director of a company who discovers a violation while performing her duties as a director.

choices.label: D
choices.text: An internal auditor of a company who discovers a violation while performing an audit of compliance.

questions.explanation: The Dodd-Frank bounty is meant for outsiders who volunteer information the SEC would not otherwise get. People who learn of the violation through a role that already obliges them to address it, such as external auditors, internal auditors, and directors, are generally excluded. A customer is under no such duty and qualifies.
questions.explanationJa: ドッド・フランク法の報奨金は、SECが他の経路では得られない情報を自発的に提供する外部者を想定している。外部監査人・内部監査人・取締役のように、既にその違反に対処する義務を負う立場を通じて違反を知った者は原則として対象外である。顧客はそのような義務を負わないので、対象となる。

questions.stem: According to COSO, which of the following components of enterprise risk management addresses an entity’s integrity and ethical values?
questions.explanation: In the ERM framework the internal environment is the counterpart of the control environment: it embraces risk management philosophy, risk appetite, board oversight, and the entity's integrity and ethical values, and it shapes how risk is viewed throughout the organization.
questions.explanationJa: ERMのフレームワークにおいて内部環境は、内部統制の統制環境に対応する要素である。リスク管理の理念、リスク選好、取締役会による監督、そして組織の誠実性と倫理観を包含し、リスクが組織全体でどう捉えられるかを規定する。

questions.stem: Jarrett Corporation is considering establishing an enterprise risk management system. Which of the following is not a benefit of enterprise risk management?

choices.label: D
choices.text: Insures that the organization shares all major risks.

questions.explanation: ERM aligns risk appetite with strategy, improves risk response decisions, reduces surprises, allows related risks to be handled together, deploys capital where risk-adjusted returns are best, and surfaces opportunities alongside threats. It does not ensure that every major risk is shared; sharing is only one of four possible responses.
questions.explanationJa: ERMは、リスク選好と戦略を整合させ、リスク対応の意思決定を改善し、不測の事態を減らし、関連するリスクをまとめて扱えるようにし、リスク調整後の収益が最も高いところへ資本を配分し、脅威とともに機会も浮かび上がらせる。主要なリスクをすべて共有させるものではない。共有は4つある対応策のうちの一つにすぎない。

questions.stem: In the COSO enterprise risk management framework, the term risk tolerance refers to

choices.label: A
choices.text: The level of risk an organization is willing to accept.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The acceptable variation with respect to a particular objective.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The risk of an event after considering management’s response.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Events that require no risk response.

questions.explanation: Risk appetite is the broad amount of risk the entity is willing to accept in pursuit of value; risk tolerance narrows that to a specific objective and states the acceptable variation around its target. Tolerance is therefore measured in the same units as the objective it relates to.
questions.explanationJa: リスク選好（risk appetite）は、価値を追求するにあたって組織が受け入れる用意のあるリスクの総量を大まかに示すものである。リスク許容度（risk tolerance）はこれを個別の目的に絞り込み、その目標値の周りで許容できる変動幅を示す。したがって許容度は、対応する目的と同じ単位で測られる。

questions.stem: Management of Warren Company has decided to respond to a particular risk by hedging the risk with futures contracts. This is an example of risk
questions.explanation: A futures hedge transfers part of the exposure to the counterparty, which is what COSO calls sharing; insurance and outsourcing work the same way. Avoidance would mean exiting the activity, reduction would mean acting to lower the exposure itself, and acceptance would mean doing nothing.
questions.explanationJa: 先物によるヘッジは、エクスポージャーの一部を取引相手に移転するものであり、COSOはこれを共有（sharing）と呼ぶ。保険や外部委託も同じ仕組みである。回避はその活動から撤退することを、低減はエクスポージャー自体を小さくする行動を、受容は何もしないことを意味する。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a technique for identifying events in an enterprise risk management program?
questions.explanation: Event identification asks what could happen, using techniques such as process flow analysis, facilitated workshops, event inventories, interviews, leading indicators, and loss event data. Probabilistic models come afterwards, in risk assessment, where the likelihood and impact of the identified events are measured.
questions.explanationJa: 事象の識別は「何が起こりうるか」を問う段階であり、プロセスフロー分析、ファシリテーテッド・ワークショップ、事象一覧、インタビュー、先行指標、損失事象データといった手法を用いる。確率モデルはその後のリスク評価の段階で、識別された事象の発生可能性と影響度を測るために使われる。

questions.stem: Devon Company is using an enterprise risk management system. Management of the company has set the company’s objectives, identified events, and assessed risks. What is the next step in the enterprise risk management process?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Establish control activities to manage the risks.

questions.explanation: The ERM sequence is objective setting, event identification, risk assessment, risk response, control activities, information and communication, and monitoring. Having sized the risks, management must decide how to handle each one before designing the controls that carry the decision out.
questions.explanationJa: ERMの手順は、目的の設定、事象の識別、リスクの評価、リスクへの対応、統制活動、情報と伝達、モニタリングの順に進む。リスクの大きさを把握した後は、その判断を実行に移す統制を設計する前に、まず各リスクへの対応方針を決めなければならない。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not an advantage of establishing an enterprise risk management system within an organization?

choices.label: B
choices.text: Provides integrated responses to multiple risks.

questions.explanation: ERM manages risk; it cannot remove it, and an entity that took no risk would earn no return. The system's purpose is to keep exposure within the appetite the board has set, which is why reduced surprises, integrated responses, and identified opportunities are the genuine benefits.
questions.explanationJa: ERMはリスクを管理するものであって、なくすことはできない。リスクを一切取らない組織は収益も得られない。この仕組みの目的は、取締役会が定めたリスク選好の範囲内にエクスポージャーを収めることである。したがって、不測の事態の減少、統合的な対応、機会の発見が真の利点となる。

questions.stem: Kelly, Inc. is considering establishing an enterprise risk management system. Which of the following is not a limitation of such a system?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Business objectives are not usually articulated.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Collusion among two or more individuals can result in system failure.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Enterprise risk management is subject to management override.

questions.explanation: The limitations are the same ones that constrain any control system: human error and breakdowns, collusion, management override, and the cost-benefit trade-off. Failure to articulate business objectives is not a limitation of ERM but a precondition for it, since objective setting is the framework's first step.
questions.explanationJa: 限界となるのは、あらゆる統制システムを制約するものと同じである。人的な誤りと機能不全、共謀、経営者による無効化、そして費用対効果の制約である。事業目的が明確にされていないことはERMの限界ではなく、その前提が満たされていない状態にすぎない。目的の設定はこのフレームワークの最初の段階だからである。
